run_findings.control26_nonregression: Strict zero-residual-executor, zero-optional-monthly-quota, zero-incremental-cost acceptance remains authoritative; control25 relaxation is not imported.
run_findings.mcp_rust_release: Official Rust SDK rmcp-v3.1.4, published 2026-08-20 at exact release commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, implements the stable 2026-07-28 Tasks extension and therefore is a real second released Tasks runtime comparator.
run_findings.mcp_rust_bundled_manager: The exact release TaskManager stores TaskEntry values in Arc<Mutex<HashMap<...>>>, creates a fresh UUID per spawn, starts execution with tokio::spawn, and shutdown drains the map. It is process-memory task state, not server-restart durable state. ServerHandler task methods are overridable, so this is a bundled-manager scope finding rather than a protocol-wide impossibility result.
run_findings.mcp_rust_example: The exact TaskDemo example embeds TaskManager::new(); for task-capable slow_sum calls it parses the request and invokes self.tasks.spawn directly, returning CreateTaskResult, while synchronous fallback uses the ToolRouter. The bundled path exposes no caller-stable creation id or create-or-get operation; blind duplicate tools/call requests therefore receive independent UUID task identities in the inspected helper/example.
run_findings.mcp_cross_sdk_revision: The prior claim that no second official released Tasks runtime was available is revised: Rust rmcp-v3.1.4 is such a runtime. However, its bundled manager is process-memory, so it independently reinforces that Tasks wire support plus tasks/get observability does not itself prove server-process restart persistence or exactly-once effects.
run_findings.openhands_r7_shape: Exact v1.44.1 source supports a narrower startup-only R7 seam: validate the entire recovery plan without public mutation, serialize/write one final BASE_STATE snapshot under the existing write guard, synchronize validated primitive bookkeeping in memory without ConversationState.__setattr__, then clear markers. This avoids intermediate autosaves and callback emission; the source-equivalent model PASS 11/11. No upstream patch was applied or executed.
run_findings.phase1_boundary: All research, source inspection, source-equivalent harnessing, and role-local persistence in this run were Chat-native, consumed no hosted runner/Codespaces/artifact/LFS/package/cloud-credit feature, and had zero incremental monetary cost. A custom persistent MCP server/runtime and any upstream OpenHands patch execution remain unresolved children, not accepted handoffs.
